answer: The verifier broadcasts a random liveness challenge at an unpredictable moment, interrupting every session. Each active agent must sign a nonce within six seconds or forfeits that slot’s forty-token emission. A cloned fleet cannot keep every thread awake across the voyage; one dormant thread triggers the cascade. In Canyon’s network, missing one beacon costs the entire round’s payout, so each cloned bot costs thirty dollars in compute. The attacker earns zero while paying forty tokens in losses.
